solcord.startup-timings: Shows how long Solcord and each of its plugins took to start, in the plugin's settings
solcord.status-presets: Allows you to remember your statuses and set them later
solcord.status-while-active: Automatically updates your online status when in a voice channel.
solcord.steam-lookup: Look up a game's price on Steam with /steam
solcord.sticker-blocker: Allows you to block stickers from being displayed.
solcord.sticker-paste: Makes picking a sticker in the sticker picker add it to your next message instead of sending it at once. A sticker button beside the message box shows the stickers waiting.
solcord.stop-auto-unread: Stops Discord from automatically bumping a channels notification setting to "All Messages"
solcord.streaks: Shows a streak next to a user when you exchange DMs with them on consecutive days.
solcord.stream-proof: Hides messages and their images while you share your screen or record it. Toggle via chat bar button.
solcord.surface-translate: Translate a channel's name and topic with /translatechannel; they are sent to Google Translate
solcord.suspicious-links: Warns you under a message when a link in it only pretends to be a site like Discord or Steam: look-alike names, letters from other alphabets and links that hide where they go. Nothing is looked up online.
solcord.talk-in-reverse: Reverses the message content before sending it.
solcord.tenor-gif-fix: Saves Tenor GIFs as real GIFs instead of videos
solcord.text-replace: Replace text in your messages. You can find pre-made rules in the #textreplace-rules channel in Solcord's Server
solcord.theme-library: Browse and install themes for Discord on your phone without leaving the app.
solcord.timezones: Shows the local time of the users you choose next to their messages
solcord.toast-notifications: Show a pop-up toast notification, configurable for DMs, group, friends, or guild channels.
solcord.tone-indicators: Explains tone indicators like /srs and /gen next to them in messages
solcord.translate: Translate messages from the message menu, translate what you send, or use /translate, with Google Translate, DeepL or Kagi; the text is sent to the service you pick
solcord.translate-plus: Rewrite your text in fun styles (small caps, upside down, fraktur, pirate...) with /translateplus
solcord.trivia: Answer a random trivia question with /trivia
solcord.trivia-ai: A plugin that helps you answer trivia questions using AI.
solcord.unit-converter: Convert metric and imperial units in a message from the message menu
solcord.universal-volume: Sets everyone in your voice channel to the same volume, and keeps new people who join at that level too.
solcord.unread-count-badge: See how many unread messages each channel of a server has with /unread
solcord.unsuppress-embeds: Allows you to unsuppress embeds in messages
solcord.urban-dictionary: Look up slang on Urban Dictionary with /urban
solcord.url-highlighter: Colors messages with links that match your patterns
solcord.user-messages-pronouns: Shows people's pronouns from their Discord profile next to their messages
solcord.userpfp: Allows you to use an animated avatar without Nitro
solcord.user-voice-show: Shows an indicator on messages from people in a voice channel, and lets you join them from the message menu
solcord.usrbg: Displays user banners from USRBG, allowing anyone to get a banner without Nitro
solcord.uuid-generator: Make a random UUID with /uuid and copy it
solcord.valid-reply: Fixes "Message could not be loaded" on replies: long-press the reply and choose Load Replied Message.
solcord.valid-user: Fix mentions for unknown users showing up as '@unknown-user' (long-press the message and choose Load Mentioned Users)
solcord.vibe-check: Adds /vibe to drop a random vaporwave mood into chat.
solcord.vibrate-on-ping: Vibrates your phone when someone mentions you or DMs you while Discord is open
solcord.view-icons: Tap avatars, banners and server icons to see them full size.
solcord.view-raw: View and copy the raw content and data of any message
solcord.voice-channel-log: Logs voice channel activity: joins, leaves, moves, server mutes, cameras and screen shares
solcord.voice-chat-utilities: Disconnect, move, mute or deafen everyone in your voice channel at once with /voiceall
solcord.voice-count: See how many people are in each voice channel of a server with /voicecount
solcord.voice-download: Download voice messages from the message menu
solcord.voice-fake-detector: Tells you when someone in your voice channel shows as muted or deafened but is talking
solcord.voice-join-messages: Receive client-side ephemeral messages when your friends join voice channels
solcord.voice-rejoin: Rejoins DM/Server call automatically when restarting Discord.
solcord.voice-server-info: Shows the Discord voice server you're connected to and its ping
solcord.voice-stats: Shows how long you've spent in voice with each user
solcord.volume-booster: Set a person's or a stream's volume above 200% with /volumebooster. Moving Discord's own volume slider for them ends the boost.
solcord.wait-for-slot: Automatically join a full voice channel when a slot opens.
solcord.webcam-start-notifier: Tells you when someone in your voice channel turns their camera on or off
solcord.wellbeing: A gentle, private dashboard of how you use Discord: screen time, messages and break reminders. Everything stays on your phone.
solcord.whitelisted-emojis: Adds the ability to disable all message emojis except for a whitelisted set.
solcord.who-reacted: See who reacted to a message with each emoji, from the message menu
solcord.whos-watching: See who is watching your stream with /viewers
solcord.wiki-lookup: /wiki pulls a short Wikipedia summary for anything (sent only to you).
solcord.word-count: Shows the word count of messages next to their time
solcord.write-upper-case: Changes the first Letter of each Sentence in Message Inputs to Uppercase
solcord.xkcd: Send an xkcd comic, the latest, a random one or a number, with /xkcd
solcord.zero-width-sanitizer: Removes invisible zero-width characters from messages to prevent fingerprinting and tracking
solcord.zip-preview: Look inside ZIP files in chats, read and save the files in them, and zip files from your phone into one to send.
